translations.guide_quickstart_sub: MPV Launcher allows seamless playback of internet streams and local media files with high-performance MPV.
translations.guide_quickstart_body:
• URL Playback: Paste video URLs from YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo, X, or direct streams in the 'Player' tab and click 'Play with MPV' or press Enter.
• Drag & Drop: Drag and drop video files (.mp4, .mkv, .webm, etc.) directly into the launcher window.
• Playback History: Last 50 media links are saved in the history list; double-click any item to replay.
translations.guide_deps_sub: Three core tools are required for optimal operation:
translations.guide_deps_body:
1. MPV: Hardware-accelerated modern media player engine.
2. yt-dlp: CLI tool extracting streams from hundreds of video platforms. Update frequently with 'Update yt-dlp (-U)'.
3. FFmpeg: Media stream demuxer and converter engine.

All tools can be downloaded and installed with one click in the 'Dependencies' tab.
translations.guide_browser_sub: Open web videos in MPV directly from your browser:
translations.guide_browser_body:
• Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera: Open 'chrome://extensions', enable 'Developer Mode', and click 'Load unpacked' selecting the Extension Folder.
• Firefox: Click 'Firefox Add-on' to install directly from the Mozilla Add-ons store.
• Native Messaging Host: Automatically configured on application launch.
translations.guide_anime4k_sub: Anime4K is a real-time AI upscaling and edge-refining shader algorithm for anime and animated content.
translations.guide_anime4k_body:
• Click 'Install Theme+Anime4K' in the 'Themes' tab to install ModernZ OSC and Anime4K GLSL shaders to %APPDATA%\mpv.
• MPV Shortcuts:
   - CTRL+0: Disable Anime4K
   - CTRL+1: Anime4K Mode A (Fast)
   - CTRL+2: Anime4K Mode B (HQ)
   - CTRL+3: Anime4K Mode C (Very Fast)
   - CTRL+4: Anime4K Mode A+A
   - CTRL+5: Anime4K Mode B+B
   - CTRL+6: Anime4K Mode C+A
translations.guide_custom_sub: Customize every visual aspect of the launcher in the 'Themes' tab:
translations.guide_custom_body:
• Corner Radii: Adjust window and card corners between 0px and 24px.
• Independent Opacity: Fine-tune transparency for cards, sidebar, inputs, and buttons.
• Frosted Glass & Shadow: Adjust blur strength and shadow intensity in real time.
• Reset to Defaults: Restore default theme and styling anytime with the red 'Reset to Defaults' button.
